name: 10512 · Carmel, NY
findings: ZIP 10512 (Carmel) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10512 (Carmel) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 6 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
